name: Codebase vulnerability management
description: SBOM-driven codebase vulnerability management playbook for operators that build or distribute software under NIS2 Art. 21(2)(e) and CRA Annex I §2. Ingest a freshly produced or refreshed SBOM, walk its declared top-level dependencies against a vulnerability database, score each finding against the operator's coordinated-vulnerability-disclosure (CVD) policy, and emit one disclosure-timeline record per finding for the downstream metrics streams. SKELETON: action bodies are placeholders pending the CORE-FANOUT sibling card; the four-state topology (ingest-sbom -> review-deps -> assess-disclosure -> track-timeline) and the per-finding disclosure-timeline record schema are pinned at this layer.

__sbom_ref__.description: Pointer to the canonical SBOM artefact for the release under review. CycloneDX or SPDX, machine-readable. Populated by the build chain upstream of this workflow.

__sbom_format__.description: Which SBOM format the artefact at __sbom_ref__ uses. One of: cyclonedx_json, cyclonedx_xml, spdx_json, spdx_tag_value.

__sbom_content_hash__.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the SBOM artefact bytes as fetched. Pinned at ingest so re-runs against a moved artefact are detectable.

__findings_ref__.description: Pointer to the per-finding result set produced by review-deps. One entry per (component, version, advisory) triple matched against the SBOM.

__disclosure_timeline_ref__.description: Pointer to the disclosure-timeline record set produced by track-timeline. One record per finding, shaped against content/evidence/codebase-vuln-management/disclosure-timeline-record.schema.json.

action--01a17a07-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: ingest-sbom
action--01a17a07-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Ingest the canonical SBOM artefact for the release under review, pin its content hash on the case, and stamp the workflow case for downstream evidence joins. Anchors CRA Annex I §2(1) SBOM production.

core_body.note: SKELETON: per-target compiler wiring lands in the CORE-FANOUT sibling card.

action--01a17a07-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: review-deps
action--01a17a07-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Walk the SBOM's top-level dependencies against a vulnerability database (NVD, OSV, GHSA) using the operator's locally-runnable scanner CLI. Default scanner is installable from an EU-hosted package index; no hosted scanner SaaS dependency. Produces one finding per (component, version, advisory) triple matched against the SBOM.

core_body.note: SKELETON: scanner-CLI invocation and finding normalisation land in the CORE-FANOUT sibling card.

action--01a17a07-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: assess-disclosure
action--01a17a07-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Score each finding from review-deps against the operator's coordinated-vulnerability-disclosure (CVD) policy: severity tier, fixed-version availability, disclosure-window deadlines per Annex I §2(2) 'without delay' plus the published CVD policy timetable. The assessment is what the per-finding disclosure-timeline record is keyed on; the CRA Article 14 actively-exploited / severe-incident reporting trigger from playbook.vuln_intake@v1 is intentionally NOT duplicated here — that decision is taken upstream against the inbound disclosure feed, this workflow only emits the proactive codebase-side timeline.

core_body.note: SKELETON: per-finding scoring and CVD-policy resolution land in the CORE-FANOUT sibling card.

action--01a17a07-0000-4000-8000-00000000.name: track-timeline
action--01a17a07-0000-4000-8000-00000000.description: Emit one disclosure-timeline record per finding from assess-disclosure, shaped against content/evidence/codebase-vuln-management/disclosure-timeline-record.schema.json. The records carry the advisory id, the affected component and version from the SBOM, the severity tier, the disclosure-window deadlines, the OCSF source_data shape, and a ref_viz field so downstream streams and dashboards can consume them off a single typed channel.

core_body.note: SKELETON: per-record emission and downstream evidence-stream wiring land in the CORE-FANOUT sibling card.
